name: KDP Coffee Roasting / Distribution - Knoxville TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (5000 Western Ave, 35.9727/-84.0032) were wrong - that point is residential NW Knoxville (geocode itself flagged movedMeters 1701). Web research (Waze, Manta, D&B, Green Mountain press releases) confirms the actual facility is the former Green Mountain Coffee / Keurig Knox County plant at 3109 Water Plant Rd, Knoxville TN 37914, in the Forks of the River Industrial Park - a 334,000 sq ft building on ~31 acres, K-Cup manufacturing + coffee roasting/distribution. Positively confirmed by Street View: building front carries the 'Keurig Dr Pepper' logo and address '3109'. Locked center 35.9436/-83.8242.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The dock apron and truck yard are open directly to Water Plant Rd via wide unbarred driveways; Street View shows no barrier arm and no guard booth - employee parking and the dock bank front the road.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any driveway.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band. A long dock-door row runs along the building's SE/south face with many trailers backed in; ~34 doors estimated (approximate - flagged).
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. A large trailer drop yard SW of the building holds rows of dozens of parked trailers, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks appear concentrated on a single (SE/south) building face - shipping and receiving not on physically separate banks. False.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur/siding runs along the SE side of the building with rail/hopper cars parked on it - the plant is rail-served (consistent with green-coffee inbound by rail).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unbarred dock apron and yard with ample paved width off Water Plant Rd - room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Multiple separate driveway access points off Water Plant Rd serve the dock yard and the drop yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Forks of the River Industrial Park is a dedicated large-warehouse industrial district within the Knoxville metro area (SE edge of the city). Classified Urban as part of the metro industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep dock apron and yard easily stack 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~70 trailers estimated across dock apron + drop yard; counts approximate - flagged.
fieldNotes.HISTORY: KDP completed a $65M sale-leaseback of this Tennessee distribution center in January 2023 (CoStar) - KDP continues to lease and operate the facility.
